name: Fine Grained Wood
author: Rob Tuytel
scope: Existing kickboxing hall reception countertop and bench slats only
physical_size_evidence: Official asset page: 0.6 m wide; official API dimensions: [600.0000238418579, 600.0000238418579] mm. Legacy API scale string 30x30CM is inconsistent; use current dimensions and published page.
visual_review: Original 1K diffuse map opened and inspected: natural dark brown fine wood grain, slight surface wear and shallow scratches; no plank gaps or saturated red tint. Compared against dark_wood and selected this lower-saturation material.

integration.uv_guidance: Map each 0.6 m of physical surface to one texture repeat. Align grain along the long direction of each bench slat/countertop; avoid stretching one texture across the entire 3.55 m countertop.
integration.unity_normal_import: TextureImporterType.NormalMap; OpenGL tangent-space source; 1024 max size
integration.unity_arm_import: sRGB=false. R=occlusion, G=roughness, B=metallic; convert G to smoothness as required by existing shader.
integration.height_displacement: None; only the three requested maps are included.
